title: Cell cycle-dependent protein dynamics in budding yeast resolved by deconvolution of bulk proteomics
authors: Zylstra A; Rovetta M; Vedelaar SR; Bleischwitz C; Fülleborn JA; van Oppen Y; Markus HP; Korbeld KT; Milias-Argeitis A; Buczak K; Schmidt A; Heinemann M
one_liner_zh: 该文通过去卷积批量蛋白质组学解析酵母细胞周期蛋白动态，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The cell division cycle is characterised by oscillatory dynamics in regulatory mechanisms and biosynthesis, coordinated with genome replication and segregation. To understand these dynamics, quantitative cell cycle-dependent protein concentration data is essential. Unfortunately, accurate resolution of cell cycle-dependent protein dynamics is challenging because single-cell proteomics is currently infeasible and bulk proteomics requires inherently imperfect cell synchronisation. Here, we developed a computational method to deconvolve cell cycle-dependent protein concentration dynamics and applied it to new budding yeast bulk proteome data. Key to this method was a yeast population model, parameterised with experimental cell cycle progression and volume growth data, for quantifying the desynchronisation in sampled populations. We performed deconvolution on 3373 proteins, using cross-validation to determine regularisation parameters, and identified 563 proteins with cell cycle-dependent dynamics. Many of these dynamics were consistent with known yeast biology and dynamic proteins were enriched for several metabolic process, extending previous observations and supporting the emerging picture of metabolic activity as varying substantially over cell cycle phases. We consider the generated cell cycle-resolved budding yeast proteome data a key resource.
abstract_zh: 细胞分裂周期以调控机制和生物合成中的振荡动力学为特征，并与基因组复制和分离相协调。为理解这些动力学，定量细胞周期依赖性蛋白质浓度数据至关重要。不幸的是，精确解析细胞周期依赖性蛋白质动力学具有挑战性，因为单细胞蛋白质组学目前不可行，而批量蛋白质组学需要本质上不完美的细胞同步化。在此，我们开发了一种计算方法来解卷积细胞周期依赖性蛋白质浓度动力学，并将其应用于新的芽殖酵母批量蛋白质组数据。该方法的关键是一个酵母群体模型，该模型以实验性细胞周期进程和体积生长数据为参数，用于量化采样群体中的去同步化。我们对3373种蛋白质进行了解卷积，使用交叉验证确定正则化参数，并识别出563种具有细胞周期依赖性动力学的蛋白质。其中许多动力学与已知的酵母生物学一致，且动态蛋白质富集于若干代谢过程，扩展了先前观察结果，并支持了代谢活性在细胞周期阶段中显著变化的崭新图景。我们认为生成的细胞周期分辨芽殖酵母蛋白质组数据是一项关键资源。
